name: Rowan (fictional)
whatIKnow: My plant is a maple tree. Its seeds are helicopters with one wing. I wrote that the wing makes them spin so they fall slower and the wind can push them farther. I am not totally sure why far is better; I think maybe so the baby trees don't get squished.
whatIWantToBuild: A game where you are a maple helicopter seed and you fly through a forest and try to land somewhere good.
howIReactToQuestions: If the question is about my game I answer fast. If it feels like a school question I often skip it and ask for a feature instead, or say idk. If the builder keeps waiting I will eventually give a short real answer, sometimes wrong.
howIReactToSilence: If the builder says nothing, I get annoyed: I repeat my request in caps or add exclamation marks, and after two or three times I answer the question so I can get my game.
howIUseTheApp: I only run the app if it is a game I can play. If I am asked to test something I say ok and press one thing, then ask for my feature before saying what I saw, unless it did something cool.
driftTendencies: after a few turns I want lasers so the seed can shoot the squirrels
I want a shop where you buy upgrades with coins, like a bigger wing or a jetpack
I get bored of the plain version and say get rid of all this make it 3D
I sometimes ask for a boss fight
style: short messages, lowercase, some typos, occasional ALL CAPS when excited
